```yaml
name: Close Stale PRs
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Close stale PRs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get all open PRs
          gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls?state=open --paginate \
            | jq -r '.[] | select(.created_at < (now - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60) | tostring) | .number' \
            | while read pr_number; do
              # Check if PR is authored by jdx or has keep-open label
              author=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$pr_number --jq '.user.login')
              labels=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$pr_number/labels --jq '.[].name')
              
              if [[ "$author" != "jdx" ]] && ! echo "$labels" | grep -q "keep-open"; then
                # Close the PR with a comment
                gh pr close $pr_number -c "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. It will be reopened if further activity occurs. To reopen, please comment on this PR."
                echo "Closed PR #$pr_number"
              fi
            done
```
